info.title: Solver Engine API
info.description:
The API implemented by solver engines interacting with the reference driver
implementation.

post.description: Solve the passed in auction instance.

schema.description: The abstract auction to be solved by the searcher.

id.description:
An opaque identifier for the auction. Will be set to `null` for
requests that are not part of an auction (when quoting token prices
for example).

tokens.description: A map of token addresses to token information.

additionalProperties.description: Information about a token relevant to the auction.

decimals.description:
The ERC20.decimals value for this token. This may be missing for
ERC20 tokens that don't implement the optional metadata extension.

symbol.description:
The ERC20.symbol value for this token. This may be missing for ERC20
tokens that don't implement the optional metadata extension.

referencePrice.description:
The reference price of this token for the auction used for scoring.
This price is only included for tokens for which there are CoW
Protocol orders.

allOf.description:
The price in wei of the native token (Ether on Mainnet for example) to
buy 10**18 of a token.

availableBalance.description:
The balance held by the Settlement contract that is available
during a settlement.

allOf.description: Amount of an ERC20 token. 256 bit unsigned integer in decimal notation.

trusted.description:
A flag which indicates that solvers are allowed to perform gas cost
optimizations for this token by not routing the trades via an AMM,
and instead use its available balances, as specified by CIP-2.

orders.description: The solvable orders included in the auction.

items.description: CoW Protocol order information relevant to execution.

uid.description:
Unique identifier for the order. Order UIDs are 56 bytes long, where
bytes [0, 32) represent the order digest used for signing, bytes
[32, 52) represent the owner address and bytes [52, 56) represent the
order's `validTo` field.

sellAmount.description: Amount of an ERC20 token. 256 bit unsigned integer in decimal notation.

fullSellAmount.description: Amount of an ERC20 token. 256 bit unsigned integer in decimal notation.

buyAmount.description: Amount of an ERC20 token. 256 bit unsigned integer in decimal notation.

fullBuyAmount.description: Amount of an ERC20 token. 256 bit unsigned integer in decimal notation.

feePolicies.description: Any protocol fee policies that apply to the order.

items.description: A fee policy that applies to an order.

oneOf.description: If the order receives more than limit price, pay the protocol a factor of the difference.

maxVolumeFactor.description: Never charge more than that percentage of the order volume.

factor.description: The factor of the user surplus that the protocol will request from the solver after settling the order

oneOf.description: A cut from the price improvement over the best quote is taken as a protocol fee.

kind.description: The trading side of the order.

Whether or not this order can be partially filled. If this is false,
then the order is a "fill-or-kill" order, meaning it needs to be
completely filled or not at all.

id.description:
An opaque ID used for uniquely identifying the liquidity within
a single auction (note that they are **not** guaranteed to be
unique across auctions). This ID is used in the solution for
matching interactions with the executed liquidity.

address.description:
The Ethereum public address of the liquidity. The actual address
that is specified is dependent on the kind of liquidity.

allOf.description: An Ethereum public address.

gasEstimate.description:
A rough approximation of gas units required to use this
liquidity on-chain.

allOf.description: An arbitrary-precision integer value.

effectiveGasPrice.description:
The current estimated gas price that will be paid when executing a
settlement. Additionally, this is the gas price that is multiplied
with a settlement's gas estimate for solution scoring.

allOf.description: Amount of an ERC20 token. 256 bit unsigned integer in decimal notation.

deadline.description:
The deadline by which a solution to the auction is required.
Requests that go beyond this deadline are expected to be cancelled
by the caller.

allOf.description: An ISO-8601 formatted date-time.

items.description: An Ethereum public address.

surplusCapturingJitOrderOwners.description: List of addresses on whose surplus will count towards the objective value of their solution (unlike other orders that were created by the solver).

solutions.description: Proposed solutions to settle some of the orders in the auction.

items.description: A computed solution for a given auction.

id.description: An opaque identifier for the solution. This is a solver generated number that is unique across multiple solutions within the auction.

prices.description:
A clearing price map of token address to price. The price can have
arbitrary denomination.

additionalProperties.description: 256 bit unsigned integer in decimal notation.

trades.description: CoW Protocol order trades included in the solution.

items.description: A trade for a CoW Protocol order included in a solution.

oneOf.description: A trade which fulfills an order from the auction.

order.description:
A reference by UID of the order to execute in a solution. The order
must be included in the auction input.

allOf.description:
Unique identifier for the order. Order UIDs are 56 bytes long, where
bytes [0, 32) represent the order digest used for signing, bytes
[32, 52) represent the owner address and bytes [52, 56) represent the
order's `validTo` field.

fee.description:
The sell token amount that should be taken as a fee for this
trade. This only gets returned for limit orders and only refers
to the actual amount filled by the trade.

executedAmount.description:
The amount of the order that was executed. This is denoted in
"sellToken" for sell orders, and "buyToken" for buy orders.

allOf.description: Amount of an ERC20 token. 256 bit unsigned integer in decimal notation.

oneOf.description: A trade with a JIT order.

executedAmount.description:
The amount of the order that was executed. This is denoted in
"sellToken" for sell orders, and "buyToken" for buy orders.

allOf.description: Amount of an ERC20 token. 256 bit unsigned integer in decimal notation.

fee.description:
The amount of sell token which should be kept to cover the gas
cost for this JIT trade. If a fee is set on a sell order the
"executedAmount" needs to be reduced accordingly to not "overfill"
the order.

allOf.description: Amount of an ERC20 token. 256 bit unsigned integer in decimal notation.

order.description: The just-in-time liquidity order to execute in a solution.

allOf.description:
A just-in-time liquidity order included in a settlement. These will
be assumed to be fill-or-kill orders with a signed fee of 0.
